observations: Photo 0 shows a blue industrial gearbox with a shaft on the right and a large mounting flange on the left.
A label/sticker is visible on the gearbox body, but the text is not fully readable in this image.
No electric motor is visible in photo 0—only the gearbox.

claims.claim: Industrial gear box and electric motor 20hp ratio 1:10
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only a gearbox; no motor is visible, and the ratio/20hp are not readable from the photo.
No clear ratio marking is readable on photo 0.
No motor appears in photo 0, so horsepower cannot be checked remotely.

risks.risk: Motor is not included or not the stated 20hp (photos show only gearbox).
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the motor nameplate (brand/model, kW/HP, voltage, RPM) and a full set showing motor + gearbox coupled.
risks.if_unproven: Price the item as gearbox only (and treat motor as not included).

risks.risk: Gearbox ratio may not be 1:10 (or may be different variant).
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the gearbox nameplate showing ratio/gear stage and model/serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-ratio gearbox (worst case for buyer: assume ratio not confirmed).

risks.risk: Condition/working status (noise, oil leaks, shaft play, missing parts) cannot be confirmed from one exterior photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the gearbox running under load (or at least a spin test) plus photos of oil level/condition and any leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: needs service/unknown condition).

risks.risk: Compatibility issues (mounting pattern, shaft size, coupling type, rotation direction).
risks.proof: Ask for measurements: input/output shaft diameter, keyway size, bolt pattern, and rotation direction; plus a photo of the coupling/interface.
risks.if_unproven: Price with compatibility risk (worst case: buyer may need adapters).

proof_requests: Photo(s) of the motor nameplate (HP/kW, voltage, RPM, brand/model) and a shot showing motor connected to the gearbox.
Close-up of the gearbox nameplate showing ratio (1:10), model, and serial number.
Video of gearbox running (or at minimum a clear spin test) and photos of oil level/any leaks.
Measurements of input/output shaft diameters and mounting bolt pattern; photo of coupling/interface.
response.reason: The seller claims a 20hp motor and a 1:10 ratio, but the only provided photo shows a gearbox and the key specs (ratio/HP) are not readable. Missing motor and nameplate proof prevents confident pricing.
